steps.label: Projekt entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat fc_v3_aa fc_v3_ab fc_v3_ac fc_v3_ad > film.tgz && cat md_v3_aa md_v3_ab > mixc.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q film.tgz)" = 1d4144c0c9f8f95eb036cf296858e63f ] && [ "$(md5 -q mixc.tgz)" = ac735d7953a4303eaea10878f03477b4 ] && rm -rf src public && tar xzf film.tgz && tar xzf mixc.tgz && ls public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render src/index.jsx P out3.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > render_time3.txt

steps.label: Ton anlegen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out3.mp4 -i mix_full.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest peloton_film3.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film3.mp4 >> render_time3.txt && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i peloton_film3.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy peloton_film3_vorschau.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film3_vorschau.mp4 >> render_time3.txt
